one_liner: Slack has a broad REST Web API with self-serve OAuth 2.0 app registration, a free developer sandbox, and an official Slack-hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Users go through the OAuth 2.0 flow to obtain user/bot tokens; bot/user tokens are also issued at app creation for the developer's own workspace.
access_notes: Every Developer Program member can provision a basic sandbox at no cost (basic sandbox has a 1-month lifespan and fewer features; extra features need a paid plan or a payment method on file, not charged). Marketplace distribution requires review, but not needed to build and test.
blocker_notes: None for building; free developer sandbox and self-serve app creation are available.

evidence.quote: In order to obtain other users' tokens, you'll need to send users through the [OAuth 2.0 authentication flow](https://api.slack.com/authentication).
When creating an app for the first time, you'll be given your own user and bot token while going through the app creation process.

A developer sandbox is an Enterprise org environment (a network of two or more Slack workspace instances) that can be used to build against all Slack features safely and securely, without an additional cost.
Every developer enrolled in the Slack Developer Program is eligible to provision a basic sandbox.
Build custom apps for your team and learn the platform. Get access to developer sandboxes, our core APIs, and the full developer toolkit.
With tools like the Slack CLI, Bolt, Block Kit and Slack MCP server already at your fingertips, you can ship AI-powered apps and agents in minutes, not months.
